Our Story

Every cup, a conversation

PAC — Passionate About Chai — began with a simple idea: Halisahar and Kanchrapara deserved a place where chai is treated with the same care as a fine brew anywhere else, without the fine-brew price tag.

We're a small, aesthetic space where friends catch up, quick bites happen between errands, and regulars will soon know exactly how they take their cutting chai. Good ambience shouldn't cost more than a ₹10 cup.
